tickets.subject: Cannot select Networking 1
tickets.message: I am trying to enroll in Networking 1 but the system says I have not met the prerequisite. I already passed Data Structures last semester. Can you please check?

tickets.subject: Midterm grade discrepancy
tickets.message: My midterm grade for Data Structures shows 2.5 but I believe it should be higher based on my exam scores. Could you please review my grade?

replies.author: Admin
replies.message: Hi Maria, we are currently reviewing your exam scores with the subject instructor. We will get back to you within 2-3 business days.

tickets.subject: Cannot log in to student portal
tickets.message: I have been trying to log in for the past two days but I keep getting an error message saying "Invalid credentials" even though I am using the correct password.

tickets.subject: Request for certificate of enrollment
tickets.message: I need a certificate of enrollment for my scholarship application. Where can I request this and how long does it take to process?

replies.author: Admin
replies.message: Hi Andrea, you can request a certificate of enrollment at the Registrar's Office. Processing takes 1-2 business days. We have already processed your request and you can claim it today.

replies.author: Andrea Lim
replies.message: Thank you so much! I will claim it today.

tickets.subject: Enrollment rejection clarification
tickets.message: My enrollment was rejected due to incomplete requirements. I have already submitted my medical certificate and Form 137. Can I resubmit my enrollment?

replies.author: Admin
replies.message: Hi Ryan, we have received your medical certificate and Form 137. We are currently verifying the documents. Once verified, we will reopen your enrollment.

tickets.subject: Request for transcript of records
tickets.message: I am graduating this semester and I need my transcript of records for my job application. Is it possible to get an advance copy?
